meta.title: Desktop Auto-Web
meta.description: Runs `dsh web` once at Desktop startup — the same command you would run by hand — so the DeepSeek Harness Web build comes up alongside the Desktop window. When the running profile is `desktop`, one `dsh web` process starts on a free local port, and the authenticated URL it prints is recorded at `$DSH_HOME/desktop-autoweb.url` and logged as `desktop-autoweb: web build listening at <url>`. A URL without its token answers 401, so use the recorded URL. Turning the bundle off stops the extra Web server; the Desktop window itself is unaffected.
